caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a high back and four horizontal, wavy slats connecting the two vertical back posts. The back posts are rounded at the top and capped with finials. The arms of the chair are flat and extend forward, connecting to slender, turned supports. The seat appears to have a woven pattern, possibly made of cane or a similar material, and is bordered by wooden framing. The lower portion of the chair has solid wood panels forming a boxed base, and the lower front edge has a decorative, scalloped cut. The overall coloration is shades of brown, depicting the natural wood grain, and the background is a plain, light beige or off-white color. The composition centers the chair, showing a three-quarter perspective from the front and slightly to the right.
title: Commode Chair
